title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_en: Removing the firewood from under the pot
summary_zh: 本页展示了成语“釜底抽薪”的标题，配图描绘了一位身穿官服、留有长须的男子被两名士兵押解的场景，暗示该成语与消除问题根源相关。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh: 东汉末年，袁绍和曹操两军对战。曹操的士兵不到一万人，驻扎在官渡。袁绍带了十万精兵，在曹军的对面扎了营。
page_text_en: At the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, Yuan Shao and Cao Cao's armies were at war. Cao Cao's soldiers numbered less than ten thousand, and they were stationed at Guan Du. Yuan Shao brought 100,000 elite troops and set up camp directly opposite Cao Cao's army.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了东汉末年袁绍与曹操在官渡对峙的背景，曹操兵力不足万人，而袁绍则拥有十万精兵。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh: "放！"袁军在小山上，"嗖嗖嗖"地向曹营射起了箭。"唉，在自己的军营里也不安全！"曹操只好和谋士们商量，设计制造了一种"霹雳车"。"砰！砰！"霹雳车投出十几斤重的石头，砸向袁军的小山头。袁军被打得头破血流，抱着脑袋逃跑了。
page_text_en: "Fire!" The Yuan army on the small hill shot arrows toward Cao's camp with a "whoosh whoosh whoosh." "Ah, it's not safe even in our own camp!" Cao Cao had to consult with his strategists and design a "Thunder Cart." "Boom! Boom!" The Thunder Cart launched stones weighing over ten jin, smashing into the Yuan army's hilltop. The Yuan soldiers were beaten to the point of bleeding, and fled in panic, clutching their heads.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了曹操军营遭袁军箭袭后，曹操与谋士设计制造霹雳车反击，用巨石击退袁军的场景。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh: 袁绍一计不成，又生一计。他让士兵悄悄挖一条长长的地道，打算从地底钻到曹营去偷袭。"嘿，前面有亮光了！"士兵们在地底下挖了几天，以为终于挖到了曹营，没想到把土刨开，前面竟然是一条深深的壕沟。
page_text_en: Yuan Shao's first plan failed, so he devised another. He ordered his soldiers to secretly dig a long tunnel, intending to sneak into Cao Cao's camp from underground. "Hey, there's light ahead!" The soldiers had dug for several days underground, thinking they had finally reached Cao Cao's camp, only to find, after breaking through the soil, a deep moat in front of them.
summary_zh: 袁绍在地道偷袭计划失败后，士兵们挖通地道却发现前方是曹操军营的深壕沟，计划落空。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh:
原来，曹军早就发现了他们的动静，已经在兵营前挖出一条又长又深的壕沟，截断了地道。
曹操见招拆招，挡住了袁绍一次又一次的攻击。可是有一个难题，他没有办法解决了，那就是军粮快要吃光了。百姓们也没有粮食交上来做军粮了，好多人都偷偷逃到袁绍那边去了。
page_text_en:
Originally, Cao's army had already discovered their movements and had dug a long and deep trench in front of the camp, cutting off the tunnels.
Cao Cao countered each of Yuan Shao's attacks effectively. However, there was one problem he couldn't solve: the army's food supplies were nearly exhausted. The common people also had no grain to contribute as military provisions, and many had secretly fled to Yuan Shao's side.
summary_zh: 本页描述了曹操军营成功截断袁绍地道进攻后，面临的军粮短缺危机，以及百姓因缺粮而逃往袁绍阵营的困境。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh:
袁绍的军粮，却是一点也不缺。
他派一位将军带领一万人马，运
了许多军粮，都囤积在官渡北边
的乌巢。袁绍的谋士对他说：
"主公应当派一支军队，在运粮队
的外围巡逻，以防曹操派兵来偷
袭。"可是袁绍不理不睬，一心
只想攻破曹营，打败曹操。
page_text_en:
Yuan Shao's military supplies, however, were not lacking at all.
He sent a general with ten thousand troops to transport
a large amount of grain, which was stored in Wuchao, north of Guandu. Yuan Shao's strategist told him:
"Your Majesty should send a detachment to patrol around the grain convoy,以防 Cao Cao's troops from stealing it."
But Yuan Shao ignored him, and was一心 only focused on breaking through Cao Cao's camp and defeating Cao Cao.
summary_zh: 本页描述袁绍军粮充足，囤积于乌巢，谋士建议派兵巡逻以防曹操偷袭，但袁绍不听劝告，一心只想攻破曹营。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh:
袁绍的另一位谋士许攸因为不受重用，又想到曹操是他的老朋友，便连夜逃出袁营，投奔了曹营。
曹操刚脱下靴子，正准备睡觉呢，一听说许攸来投奔他，高兴得鞋子都没穿，光着脚就跑出来迎接。他拍着手欢迎许攸说："哎呀，你肯来，我的大业就有希望了。"
page_text_en:
Yuan Shao's other strategist, Xu You, because he was not valued, and thinking that Cao Cao was his old friend, secretly fled from Yuan's camp at night and went to Cao's camp.
Cao Cao had just taken off his boots and was about to go to sleep when he heard that Xu You had come to join him. Overjoyed, he didn't even put on his shoes, ran out barefoot to welcome him. He clapped his hands and welcomed Xu You, saying, "Ah, now that you've come, my great cause has hope!"
summary_zh: 袁绍的谋士许攸因不受重用而投奔曹操，曹操欣喜若狂，光着脚迎接他，认为自己的大业有了希望。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh:
为了不把许攸吓跑，曹操故意大笑着说道："哈哈，这你不用担心，我的粮草还可以吃一年。"
许攸冷笑道："一年？没有那么多吧！"
许攸坐下来说："袁绍来势凶猛，十万精兵，你打算怎么对付？现在你的粮草还有多少？"
page_text_en:
To avoid scaring Xu You away, Cao Cao deliberately laughed and said, "Haha, don't worry, my grain and fodder can last for a year."
Xu You coldly replied, "A year? There's not that much!"
Xu You then sat down and said, "Yuan Shao is advancing fiercely with 100,000 elite troops. How do you plan to deal with him? And how much grain and fodder do you have left?"
summary_zh: 许攸投奔曹操后，询问其粮草储备情况，曹操为稳住他而声称粮草可吃一年，许攸则表示怀疑。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh: 许攸站起来假装要走："你难道不想打败袁绍吗？为什么在我这个老朋友面前还说假话！"曹操见许攸知道了自己底细，急忙拉住他，说出实情："唉，刚才是跟你开玩笑。我军营里的粮草，只能吃一个月了。不瞒你说，我正在为这事儿发愁呢！"曹操连忙改口说："对，确实没有那么多，只能吃半年了。"
page_text_en: Xu You stood up pretending to leave: "Don't you want to defeat Yuan Shao? Why are you still lying to me, your old friend!" Cao Cao, seeing that Xu You had learned his secret, hurriedly pulled him back and told the truth: "Ah, I was just joking with you. The grain in my camp can only last for one month. I'm honestly worried about this!" Cao Cao quickly changed his story: "Yes, there's not that much. It can only last for half a year."
summary_zh: 许攸假装要离开，质问曹操为何在自己面前说谎，曹操无奈坦白军粮仅够吃一个月，随后又改口称可吃半年。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh: 许攸见曹操说了实话，这才悄悄对他说："我知道你的情况很危险，特地来给你报个信。袁绍有一万多车粮草囤积在乌巢，防备很松懈。你只要带一支轻骑兵去袭击，把他的粮草都烧光，我保证，不出三天，袁军就不战自败了！"
page_text_en: Xu You saw that Cao Cao had told the truth, so he quietly said to him: "I know your situation is very dangerous. I've come specially to give you a warning. Yuan Shao has over ten thousand carts of grain and fodder stored in Wu Chao, and their defenses are very lax. If you lead a small cavalry force to attack and burn all his supplies, I guarantee that within three days, Yuan's army will collapse without even fighting!"
summary_zh: 许攸向曹操透露袁绍在乌巢囤积大量粮草且防备松懈，建议曹操派轻骑兵突袭烧毁粮草，以使袁军不战自败。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh: 曹操高兴极了，立刻找来将领，吩咐他们守好大营。然后，他亲自带领五千名骑兵，换上袁军的衣服，打出袁军的旗号，趁夜从小道出了营。士兵们嘴里衔着小木棍，又绑上了马嘴，生怕发出一丁点儿声音。每个人都带上了一捆柴草。
page_text_en: Cao Cao was overjoyed. He immediately called his generals and instructed them to guard the main camp. Then, he personally led five thousand cavalrymen, dressed in Yuan army uniforms, flying Yuan army banners, and slipped out of the camp through a small path under cover of night. The soldiers held small sticks in their mouths, and their horses' mouths were bound, afraid of making even the slightest sound. Everyone carried a bundle of firewood.
summary_zh: 曹操在得知袁绍粮草囤积于乌巢且防备松懈后，立即部署突袭计划，亲自率领五千骑兵伪装成袁军，趁夜从小道出发，士兵们衔木棍、绑马嘴以保持安静，并携带柴草准备烧粮。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh: “站住！你们是干什么的？”经过袁绍的军营时，忽然有一队巡逻兵迎面走了过来。曹军都不敢说话，只有一名将领高举着“袁”字旗说：“袁公担心曹军袭击我们的粮草，派我们去加强守卫呢！”巡逻兵看看他们的旗子，立刻给他们让了路。
page_text_en: "Stop! What are you doing?" As they passed through Yuan Shao's camp, a patrol suddenly approached. The Cao army dared not speak, but one officer raised a banner with the character "Yuan" and said, "General Yuan is worried that the Cao army might attack our grain supplies, so he sent us to strengthen the guard!" The patrol soldiers looked at their banner and immediately let them pass.
summary_zh: 曹操派兵伪装成袁绍军队，趁夜突袭乌巢。途中遇到袁绍巡逻兵，曹军将领高举袁字旗，谎称奉命加强粮草守卫，成功骗过巡逻兵，顺利通过袁绍军营。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh: 曹军到了乌巢，点燃手中的柴草，扔向了粮仓。"着火了！有人偷袭！"看守粮草的袁军将领这才发现潜入了伪装的曹军，急忙派人过来。袁绍听说曹操袭击了乌巢，生气地说："他烧我的粮草，我就攻破他的大营，让他无家可归。"于是，他派了两名大将，带重兵去攻打曹军大营。他烧我的粮草，我就攻他大营！
page_text_en: The Cao army arrived at Wucao, lit the firewood in their hands, and threw it into the granary. "Fire! Someone is attacking!" The Yuan army commander guarding the grain only then realized that disguised Cao troops had infiltrated, and hurriedly sent people to respond. When Yuan Shao heard that Cao Cao had attacked Wucao, he angrily said, "He burns my grain, I'll attack his camp and leave him with no home to return to." So, he sent two generals with heavy troops to attack Cao's camp. He burns my grain, I'll attack his camp!
summary_zh: 曹军突袭乌巢，点燃粮草引发大火，袁军将领发现后紧急应对。袁绍得知粮草被烧，怒而派重兵攻打曹军大营。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh: 一位将领劝袁绍说："主公，曹操的营寨坚固，不一定攻得下来。可是他带着精兵去攻乌巢，咱们的乌巢一定会被攻破。到时候我们失去了粮草，都要成为曹军的俘虏呀！"袁绍这才拨了一支骑兵，赶去了乌巢。
page_text_en: A general advised Yuan Shao: "Lord, Cao Cao's camp is well-fortified and may not be easy to capture. But he has taken his elite troops to attack Wucao. Our Wucao will surely be breached. Once we lose our grain supplies, we will all become prisoners of Cao's army!" Yuan Shao then dispatched a cavalry unit to rush to Wucao.
summary_zh: 一位将领劝说袁绍，曹操主力攻打乌巢，袁绍的粮草基地将危在旦夕，袁绍于是派骑兵赶往乌巢救援。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh: 袁绍的骑兵到了乌巢，曹操身边的侍卫忙提醒他：“主公，袁军的增援来了！”曹操一边挥刀大战，一边生气地大喝道：“专心杀敌，等他们到了我背后，你再来报告！”曹操拼死作战，终于大破乌巢的袁军，把袁军的粮草烧得一干二净。
page_text_en: Yuan Shao's cavalry arrived at Wucao. Cao Cao's attendant hurriedly reminded him: "Your Majesty, Yuan's reinforcements are coming!" Cao Cao, while fiercely fighting with his sword, angrily shouted: "Focus on killing the enemy. Report to me only when they reach my back!" Cao Cao fought desperately and finally defeated Yuan Shao's army at Wucao, burning all of Yuan's grain supplies to the ground.
summary_zh: 曹操在乌巢与袁绍增援骑兵激战，命令部下专注杀敌，最终大破袁军，将粮草烧毁殆尽。

title_en: Pulling the Firewood from Under the Pot
page_text_ocr_zh:
听说粮草被烧光，袁军惊慌失措，再也不听将领的指挥，都逃跑了。袁绍也只好率领八百名骑兵渡过黄河，落荒而逃。
不论什么时候，打仗都是“兵马未动，粮草先行”，粮草是军队的生命。曹操烧掉袁军的粮草，就切断了袁军的生路，这就如同从锅底下抽走柴火，水便再也不会沸腾。这样的计策，就叫“釜底抽薪”。
page_text_en:
Hearing that their grain supplies had been burned to ashes, Yuan's army panicked and lost all discipline, fleeing in disarray. Yuan Shao could only lead eight hundred cavalrymen across the Yellow River, fleeing in disgrace.
No matter when, in warfare, it is always 'the troops move not until the supplies are ready'—supplies are the lifeblood of an army. By burning Yuan's grain, Cao Cao cut off Yuan's lifeline, just like removing the firewood from under a pot—once the fire is gone, the water will never boil again. This kind of strategy is called 'removing the firewood from under the pot' (Fu Di Chu Xin).
summary_zh: 袁军因粮草被烧而溃散，袁绍率残部渡河逃走。画面解释了“釜底抽薪”这一计策的含义，即通过摧毁敌方粮草来瓦解其战斗力。
